# plot.clock_atlas { #falconage.plot.clock_atlas }

```python
plot.clock_atlas(
    result,
    bench,
    *,
    dataset_col='dataset',
    min_datasets=2,
    coverage_floor=0.8,
    max_clocks=40,
)
```

One figure comparing every clock across every pooled study.

Optional by design: it needs several studies to say anything, so it is not
part of the default figure set and :func:`falconage.plot.save_all` emits it
only when ``dataset_col`` names at least ``min_datasets`` studies.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                                                                                                         | Default    |
|----------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| result         |        | A combined :class:`~falconage.score.FalconResult`, normally from :func:`falconage.score.combine`.                                   | _required_ |
| bench          |        | The matching :class:`~falconage.analysis.BenchmarkResult`.                                                                          | _required_ |
| min_datasets   | int    | Refuse below this many studies. Two is the floor at which "consistent across cohorts" means anything.                               | `2`        |
| coverage_floor | float  | Drawn on panel F; use the same value the run was scored with.                                                                       | `0.8`      |
| max_clocks     | int    | Keep the highest-scoring this many, so a full catalogue still fits a page. Truncation is stated in the subtitle rather than silent. | `40`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                    |
|--------|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | (figure, data) | The frame is one row per clock and carries every number drawn. |
